d:
Two Special Police Officers (SPOs), identified as Babi Chand and Rashpal Kumar, were found dead in the forests of Dachhan in Jammu and Kashmir’s Kishtwar on November 12. Both had bullet injuries, and their service weapons were missing. Security agencies suspect a possible terror attack, but the attackers' identity and the motive are yet to be officially confirmed.
